runtime_version_proof: Not present in the exported service resource; analysis checkout is not runtime proof. The witnesses show the pre-1395 full-history ticket-read path.
benchmark_kind: observational production/dev traffic baseline, not controlled load test
per_request_project: unknown: route spans do not export project values or query filters; do not claim all requests are project lingtai

github_1395_snapshot.meaning: Issue updatedAt is not evidence of board deployment time or the exact landing time.

comparison_requirements: Match route, method and RSC flag; report sample sizes and window boundaries.
Record runtime cutover first; only requests started after it and confirmed to run fixed code belong to after.
Record cold/warm state, active pages/concurrency, project filter and actual draft/history size when known.
An unobserved stage is missing, not zero; counts require events.read instrumentation.
Use per-request percentiles, not percentiles of already aggregated buckets; compare counts as well as elapsed time.
